en.headline: Ex-lawmaker Wong Kam-fai faces four driving charges next week
en.dek: Police have charged former legislator Wong Kam-fai with drink-driving and related offences over a June collision at the CUHK campus; he appears at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on 9 September.
body: Police have charged former Legislative Council member Wong Kam-fai with four driving-related offences, and he is scheduled to appear at Sha Tin Magistrates’ Courts on Wednesday, 9 September, local media reported, citing police action.

The charges are drink driving, careless driving, failing to stop after an accident, and failing to report an accident. They relate to an incident on 29 June in which Wong is alleged to have collided with two parked vehicles on the Chinese University of Hong Kong campus and left the scene before returning. He has not entered a plea.

Wong, 66, resigned from the Legislative Council on 3 July, saying the matter had caused disturbance to the Council and the public. The university earlier said it had suspended his administrative duties as associate dean (external) of the Faculty of Engineering. He is entitled to the presumption of innocence.

zh.headline: 前議員黃錦輝被控酒駕等四罪 下周三提堂
zh.dek: 警方已就六月中大校園交通意外向立法會前議員黃錦輝落案起訴酒後駕駛等四項控罪，案件下周三在沙田裁判法院提堂。
body: 據本地傳媒引述警方消息，前選舉委員會界別立法會議員黃錦輝已被落案起訴四項與駕駛有關的控罪，將於九月九日（星期三）上午在沙田裁判法院提堂。
四項控罪分別為酒後駕駛、不小心駕駛、發生交通意外後沒有停車，以及發生交通意外後沒有報案，涉及六月二十九日在香港中文大學校園內懷疑撞及兩輛停泊私家車後駛離現場的事件。他尚未答辯。
六十六歲的黃錦輝已於七月三日辭任立法會議員，當時表示事件為社會及立法會帶來困擾。中大較早前宣布暫停其工程學院副院長（外務）行政職務。案件仍未開審，他享有無罪推定。
